_meta.description: Null-state filtering on the nullable income field of intake.pulse via FILTER_NULL. Mode lives in Values[0] as the literal string "is_null" (keep only nulls) or "is_not_null" (keep only present values). This example takes the "is_not_null" path — the canonical data-quality keep-only-present shape — then counts the surviving forms: the forms with a blank income drop out, so fewer rows survive than the cohort holds.
_meta.name: filter_null_present
